title: FactoryRecoveryCheckpoint
description: A Factory outcome's recovery checkpoint — the branch, commits and remaining checks preserved across a paused or interrupted dispatch attempt, so a retry resumes only what is left rather than restarting or silently redoing completed work (spec-factory.md §2 'recovery checkpoints'). Carried verbatim into the next dispatch attempt's prompt and into any continuation's `factory.outcome.json` record. Modeled from the repo's own proven `factory.service` checkpoint handling. Fulfils demand `factory-20260911-interface-extraction` criterion 1.

branch.description: The working branch the in-progress attempt left work on. Empty string before any attempt has recorded a checkpoint.

commits.description: Commit SHAs already made on `branch` as of this checkpoint — preserved so a retry never re-does or force-overwrites them.

summary.description: Human-readable account of what this checkpoint represents.

remainingChecks.description: The specific checks (tests, verifications) still outstanding as of this checkpoint. A retry is scoped to resuming exactly these, not the whole step.
